notes.title: Rewrite Harvest festa! now available on Steam!
notes.notes: [h3]What is Rewrite Harvest festa?[/h3][p]This is a collection of stories that weren't told in the main storyline of Rewrite. Includes 6 stories featuring the heroines of Rewrite. Also included is the unlockable, "Rewrite Quest", a first person-style dungeon crawler minigame.[/p][p][/p][p]Please Note: Rewrite Harvest festa! contains spoilers for Rewrite+ so please be sure to have completed Rewrite+ prior to playing Rewrite Harvest festa![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1856600/Rewrite_Harvest_festa?snr=2___"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Haven't tried Rewrite+ yet? It is also on sale this week as part of the Steam Week Long Deal! Save 60% off till July 21, 2025.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1680000/Rewrite?snr=2___"][/dynamiclink][/p]
